notes: All 16 cited URLs opened with curl (HTTP 200). Verdicts are based only on visible page text, with HTML comments and scripts removed.
Kumamoto: the EN/KO info pages do not show the Jul-Aug extended hours (9:00-19:00) and the KO pet rules are stale. Use the Japanese /info/ page (2026-04) as the primary source for hours and rules.
Dogo: brand-level payment details appear only as logo images. The Korean FAQ is stale for towel prices and airport time.
Otaru: the city page and parking page are more than 12 months old (stale_source).
None of the claims are coordinates, so no map cross-check was needed.
